parole.significato: A member of an alliance of African-American street gangs based in southern California.
parole.testo: From Chumashan. The gang was named after Piru Street, a residential street in Compton and neighboring Willowbrook; but is now often explained by various backronyms, such as Powerful Indestructible Ruthless Untouchables.
